sections.heading: What it is
sections.body: A Minimoog Model D-style monophonic synth: three oscillators into a 4-pole transistor ladder low-pass filter, with separate filter and loudness contour envelopes. Mono with last-note priority and glide.

sections.heading: Oscillators
sections.body: Each osc has a Range (LO/32'/16'/8'/4'/2') and Waveform (Tri/Saw/Square/Wide+Narrow Pulse). Osc 2 and 3 have fine Tune. Set Osc3 Kbd = Off to free-run osc 3 as a modulation source.

sections.heading: Filter
sections.body: Cutoff, Emphasis (resonance, self-oscillates near max) and Contour Amt (how far the filter envelope opens the cutoff). Filter A/D/S shape that envelope; Kbd Track makes cutoff follow pitch.

sections.heading: Modulation
sections.body: Mod Mix crossfades Osc 3 and Noise as the mod source. Route it to pitch (Osc Mod) and/or cutoff (Filter Mod).

sections.heading: Decay switch
sections.body: When On, note release uses the Decay time (Model D behavior). Off gives a short release.
